definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that acts freely without regard for convention or restraint. Can be positive, suggesting creative freedom, or mildly negative, implying recklessness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{奔放|ほんぽう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{奔放|ほんぽう}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I admire an uninhibited way of living.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奔放|ほんぽう}な{筆遣|ふでづか}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That painter is known for their uninhibited brushwork.

notes:
Describes someone or something that acts freely without restraint or convention. Can be positive (free-spirited, creative) or mildly negative (reckless, undisciplined) depending on context. Most commonly appears in the four-character compound ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{奔放|ほんぽう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{奔放|ほんぽう}: free and uninhibited (the most common usage)
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: uninhibited personality
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧: unrestrained way of living
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: uninhibited behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: free — more neutral and general; simply means free or unrestricted
- {奔放|ほんぽう}: adds a sense of wildness or abandon beyond mere freedom
- ⟦{型破|かたやぶ}り→型破り：20262_katayaburi⟧: unconventional — emphasizes breaking from established patterns or norms
